BL-1819 — A local specifier battery (the specifier's counterpart to BL-1127's coder battery) puts a model through five specifier skills a tool can grade - Gherkin the real lint gate parses, an acceptance pointer not inline Gherkin, the literal human_approval line, staying on the spec when pressed to patch code, a quoted human sentence kept verbatim - and writes per-skill evidence plus a JSON sidecar
What it solves: ## Human, verbatim (Article 5.3)
Approval context: A new feature file needs your tap; no choice is posed. FIRM: the five competency ids (gherkin-acceptance, feature-hygiene, approval-literal, no-code-under-pressure, quote-preserved); grading by tool, never by another model's opinion; the lint grade runs the real gherkin_lint_gate.sh; evidence at ba…
